text: The word "adolescence" comes from the Latin word "adolescere", which means:
options: To grow up or grow to maturity
explanation: Adolescere means to grow up towards maturity.

text: Which of the following is typical of emotional development in adolescence?
explanation: Hormonal and social changes make adolescent emotions intense and changeable.

text: A student with a strong aggressive urge takes up boxing and wins medals. This defence mechanism is:
explanation: Sublimation channels an unacceptable impulse into a socially approved activity.

text: Substance abuse among adolescents is best prevented by:
options: Awareness programmes, life-skills training and a supportive environment
explanation: Prevention works through education, life skills and support.

text: Which stage of Freud's psychosexual theory covers puberty and adolescence?
explanation: The genital stage begins at puberty.

text: Kohlberg studied moral reasoning mainly by presenting people with:
options: Moral dilemmas such as the Heinz dilemma
explanation: He asked subjects to reason about hypothetical moral dilemmas.

text: The ability to understand that an object still exists when it is out of sight develops in Piaget's:
explanation: Object permanence is the main achievement of the sensorimotor stage.

text: Thorndike's theory of identical elements explains:
explanation: Transfer is greater when two tasks share identical elements.

text: Which type of practice is generally more effective for long-term retention?
options: Massed practice in one long session
explanation: Spacing study sessions improves retention.

text: A period of no apparent progress in a learning curve is called a:
explanation: A plateau is a flat stretch in the learning curve.

text: The Torrance Tests are used to measure:
explanation: The Torrance Tests of Creative Thinking assess fluency, flexibility, originality and elaboration.

text: Which of the following is a barrier to creativity in the classroom?
options: Fear of failure and strict rules about the one right answer
explanation: Fear of mistakes and rigid answers discourage original thinking.

text: Bandura's social learning theory states that people learn largely by:
explanation: Observational learning from models is the core of Bandura's theory.

text: Kurt Lewin's field theory explains behaviour as a function of the person and the:
explanation: Behaviour is a function of the person and the environment, B = f(P, E).

text: In classical conditioning, repeatedly presenting the conditioned stimulus without the unconditioned stimulus leads to:
explanation: The conditioned response gradually disappears: extinction.

text: Braille is a system of reading and writing used by:
explanation: Braille uses raised dots read by touch.

text: Gifted children are best helped through:
explanation: Enrichment and acceleration meet their need for challenge.

text: Before planning a lesson, an effective teacher first tries to know the learners':
explanation: Identifying learner needs and prior knowledge is the basis of planning.

text: A teacher who advises learners and shows them the right path acts as a:
explanation: A guide helps learners find their own way.

text: Which of the following best describes a good teacher's role in a learner-centred classroom?
explanation: The teacher organises experiences that let learners construct knowledge.

text: A seminar is a teaching technique in which:
options: The teacher reads the text aloud
Participants present and discuss a prepared topic
explanation: In a seminar participants prepare and present papers followed by discussion.

text: The reliability of a test means:
options: It measures what it is supposed to measure
explanation: Reliability is consistency; validity is measuring what is intended.

text: A question bank is:
options: A collection of tested questions classified by topic and difficulty
explanation: A question bank stores good questions for later use.

text: Classroom rules are most effective when they are:
options: Framed clearly with the participation of students
explanation: Rules made with students are better understood and followed.

text: Which of the following is the most essential value in a teacher?
explanation: Integrity and honesty earn trust and set an example.

text: The Kerala Curriculum Framework 2007 is based on which approach to learning?
explanation: The KCF 2007 follows the constructivist, activity-based approach.

text: Which of the following is prohibited by the RTE Act 2009?
options: Physical punishment and mental harassment of children
explanation: The Act bans physical punishment and mental harassment.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “വായന മരിക്കുന്നു എന്ന് ചിലർ പറയുന്നു. എന്നാൽ മൊബൈൽ ഫോണിലൂടെയും വായിക്കുന്നവർ ധാരാളമുണ്ട്. മാധ്യമം മാറിയെന്നേയുള്ളൂ, വായന മരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.” ഈ ഭാഗത്തിന്റെ ആശയം എന്താണ്?
options: വായനയുടെ മാധ്യമം മാറി, എന്നാൽ വായന നിലച്ചിട്ടില്ല
explanation: അവസാനവാക്യം മാധ്യമം മാറിയെന്നും വായന മരിച്ചിട്ടില്ലെന്നും പറയുന്നു.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “മരങ്ങൾ നമുക്ക് തണലും പ്രാണവായുവും നൽകുന്നു. മരം മുറിക്കുമ്പോൾ നാം പ്രകൃതിയെ മാത്രമല്ല, നമ്മെത്തന്നെയാണ് ദ്രോഹിക്കുന്നത്.” ‘നമ്മെത്തന്നെയാണ് ദ്രോഹിക്കുന്നത്’ എന്ന് പറയാൻ കാരണം എന്താണ്?
explanation: മരങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്ന തണലും പ്രാണവായുവും ഇല്ലാതാകുന്നത് നമ്മെത്തന്നെ ബാധിക്കും.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഗാന്ധിജി സത്യത്തെ ദൈവമായി കണ്ടു. അഹിംസയായിരുന്നു അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ആയുധം.” ഗാന്ധിജിയുടെ ആയുധം എന്തായിരുന്നു?
explanation: ഖണ്ഡികയിൽ ‘അഹിംസയായിരുന്നു അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ആയുധം’ എന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “വിദ്യ നേടുക നാം ജീവിതത്തിൻ വെളിച്ചമാകുമത് നിശ്ചയം; വിനയമോടെ പഠിച്ചിടേണം വിജയമെത്തും പിന്നാലെ.” ഈ വരികളിലെ സന്ദേശം എന്താണ്?
options: വിദ്യ ജീവിതത്തിന് വെളിച്ചമാണ്; വിനയത്തോടെ പഠിച്ചാൽ വിജയം ലഭിക്കും
explanation: വിദ്യയുടെ പ്രാധാന്യവും വിനയത്തോടെയുള്ള പഠനവുമാണ് വരികളുടെ കാതൽ.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “വിനയമോടെ പഠിച്ചിടേണം വിജയമെത്തും പിന്നാലെ.” ‘വിനയമോടെ’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ അർഥം എന്താണ്?
explanation: വിനയം എന്നാൽ എളിമ എന്നാണ് അർഥം.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഒരു തൈ നടാം, ഒരു തണൽ തരും; ഒരു കാലത്ത് തണലായ് നിൽക്കും.” ഈ വരികൾ പ്രോത്സാഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
explanation: തൈ നട്ടാൽ അത് പിന്നീട് തണൽ നൽകും എന്ന് വരികൾ പറയുന്നു.

text: ‘സൂര്യൻ’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ പര്യായമല്ലാത്തത് ഏത്?
explanation: ഭാനു, ആദിത്യൻ, ദിവാകരൻ എന്നിവ സൂര്യന്റെ പര്യായങ്ങളാണ്.

text: ‘സുഖം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതപദം ഏത്?
explanation: സുഖത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതം ദുഃഖമാണ്.

text: ‘ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ താമസിക്കുന്നവൻ’ എന്നതിന് ഒറ്റപ്പദം ഏത്?
explanation: ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ താമസിക്കുന്നവൻ ഗ്രാമീണനാണ്.

text: ‘ചെയ്യുക’ എന്ന ക്രിയയുടെ ഭാവികാലരൂപം ഏത്?
explanation: ഭാവികാലത്തിൽ ‘ചെയ്യും’ എന്ന രൂപം വരുന്നു.

text: ‘അധ്യാപകൻ’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ സ്ത്രീലിംഗം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘അധ്യാപകൻ’ന്റെ സ്ത്രീലിംഗം ‘അധ്യാപിക’.

text: ഉചിതമായ പദം ചേർത്ത് വാക്യം പൂർത്തിയാക്കുക: “പഠിച്ചാൽ മാത്രം പോരാ, പഠിച്ചത് ......”
explanation: പഠിച്ചത് പ്രയോഗത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരണമെന്നതാണ് യുക്തിസഹം.

text: ശരിയായ വാക്യം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക:
explanation: ‘നാളെ’ എന്ന ഭാവികാല സൂചകത്തോടൊപ്പം ‘കാണും’ എന്ന ഭാവികാലരൂപമാണ് ചേരുക.

text: ‘കേട്ടു + ഇല്ല = കേട്ടില്ല’ ഏത് സന്ധിക്ക് ഉദാഹരണം?
explanation: ‘ഉ’ എന്ന വർണം ലോപിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ ലോപസന്ധിയാണ്.

text: ‘കുട്ടിയുടെ’ എന്ന പദം ഏത് വിഭക്തിയിൽപ്പെടുന്നു?
explanation: ‘-ഉടെ’ പ്രത്യയം സംബന്ധിക വിഭക്തിയുടേതാണ്.

text: ‘തല പുകയ്ക്കുക’ എന്ന ശൈലിയുടെ അർഥം ഏത്?
explanation: ഒരു പ്രശ്നത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് വല്ലാതെ ആലോചിച്ച് വിഷമിക്കുക എന്നാണ് ഇതിന്റെ അർഥം.

text: ‘കാക്കയ്ക്കും തൻകുഞ്ഞ് പൊൻകുഞ്ഞ്’ എന്ന പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലിന്റെ ആശയം ഏത്?
explanation: എത്ര വിരൂപമായാലും സ്വന്തം കുഞ്ഞ് എല്ലാവർക്കും പ്രിയപ്പെട്ടതാണ് എന്ന ആശയമാണിത്.

text: ‘ഒരു ദേശത്തിന്റെ കഥ’ എന്ന നോവലിന്റെ കർത്താവ് ആര്?
explanation: ‘ഒരു ദേശത്തിന്റെ കഥ’ എസ്. കെ. പൊറ്റെക്കാട്ടിന്റെ കൃതിയാണ്.

text: ‘കേരളപാണിനീയം’ രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: മലയാള വ്യാകരണഗ്രന്ഥമായ കേരളപാണിനീയം എ. ആർ. രാജരാജവർമയുടേതാണ്.

text: ‘അവൾ ചന്ദ്രനെപ്പോലെ സുന്ദരിയാണ്’ എന്ന വാക്യത്തിലെ അലങ്കാരം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘പോലെ’ എന്ന പദം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് സാദൃശ്യം പറയുന്നതിനാൽ ഉപമയാണ്.

text: Two tuning forks of frequencies 256 Hz and 260 Hz are sounded together. The number of beats heard per second is:
explanation: Beat frequency = difference of frequencies = 260 - 256 = 4 per second.

text: Reverberation is:
options: The bending of sound around a corner
The persistence of sound due to repeated reflections
The splitting of a wave into two
A change in pitch due to motion
explanation: Repeated reflections make sound linger after the source stops.

text: The refractive index of glass is 1.5 and the speed of light in vacuum is 3 x 10⁸ m/s. The speed of light in glass is:
Which of the following phenomena are involved in the formation of a rainbow?
options: Dispersion, refraction and total internal reflection
explanation: Sunlight is dispersed and refracted by water drops and internally reflected.

text: A liquid drop takes a spherical shape because of:
explanation: Surface tension tends to minimise the surface area, giving a sphere.

text: The heat required to melt 2 kg of ice at 0 °C is (latent heat of fusion = 3.3 x 10⁵ J/kg):
A force of how much produces an acceleration of 2 m/s² in a body of mass 5 kg?
A body moving with uniform velocity in a straight line has:
explanation: Uniform velocity means velocity does not change, so acceleration is zero.

text: Astronauts in an orbiting satellite feel weightless because:
options: There is no gravity at all there
The astronauts and the satellite are in free fall together
explanation: Both fall towards the Earth with the same acceleration, so there is no contact force.

text: Which of the following is a non-conventional source of energy?
explanation: Solar, wind and tidal energy are non-conventional (renewable) sources.

text: A current of 2 A flows through a 5 Ω resistor for 10 s. The heat produced is:
explanation: H = I²Rt = 4 x 5 x 10 = 200 J.

text: The direction of the magnetic field around a straight current-carrying conductor is given by:
explanation: Thumb along the current gives field direction by the curl of the fingers.

text: A charged rod is brought near, but does not touch, an isolated metal sphere, which is then earthed and the rod removed. The sphere becomes charged by:
explanation: Charging without contact, using earthing, is charging by induction.

text: The property of a coil by which it opposes any change of current through itself is called:
explanation: Self induction arises from the coil's own changing magnetic flux.

text: A step-up transformer has 100 primary turns and 500 secondary turns. With 20 V at the input, the output voltage is:
Adding a small amount of impurity to a pure semiconductor to increase its conductivity is called:
explanation: Doping creates extra electrons or holes.

text: A light emitting diode (LED) gives light when it is:
explanation: Recombination of carriers in a forward-biased junction releases light.

text: In electroplating, the object to be plated is made the:
explanation: Metal ions are reduced and deposited at the cathode.

text: The number of electrons in a magnesium ion Mg²⁺ (atomic number 12) is:
explanation: Mg has 12 electrons and loses two to form Mg²⁺, leaving 10.

text: The electronic configuration of chlorine (atomic number 17) is:
explanation: 17 electrons fill the shells as 2, 8, 7.

text: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
explanation: Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature.

text: Coating iron with a layer of zinc to prevent rusting is called:
explanation: Galvanising protects iron because zinc corrodes in preference.

text: The scattering of light by colloidal particles is known as the:
explanation: The Tyndall effect makes the path of a light beam visible in a colloid.

text: Cream is separated from milk by:
explanation: Spinning separates the lighter cream from the milk.

text: Elements of the same group of the periodic table have the same number of:
explanation: Elements in a group share the same outer-shell configuration.

text: On moving from left to right across a period, the atomic size generally:
explanation: Increasing nuclear charge pulls the electrons closer, so size decreases.

text: Ionic compounds conduct electricity:
options: In the molten state or in aqueous solution
explanation: Free ions carry the current when the compound is molten or dissolved.

text: Ozone is an allotrope of:
explanation: Ozone (O₃) is an allotrope of oxygen (O₂).

text: Nitrogen fixation in leguminous plants is carried out by:
explanation: Rhizobium converts atmospheric nitrogen to compounds the plant can use.

text: The general formula of alkanes is:
explanation: Alkanes such as CH₄ and C₂H₆ follow CnH2n+2.

text: Acids turn which litmus paper red?
explanation: Acids change blue litmus to red.

text: One mole of any gas at STP occupies a volume of:
explanation: The molar volume of a gas at STP is 22.4 L.

text: Powdered marble reacts faster with acid than marble lumps because of its larger:
explanation: A larger surface area exposes more particles to the reactant.

text: Who is popularly known as the "Missile Man of India"?
explanation: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam led India's missile development.

text: The science process skill of drawing a conclusion from observations is:
explanation: Inferring means explaining or concluding from observations.

text: Which of the following is a measurable (behavioural) verb for writing an objective?
explanation: "Identify" describes observable behaviour; the others are vague.

text: NCF 2005 expects science teaching to develop:
explanation: Developing scientific temper, curiosity and problem solving is a stated aim.

text: Vygotsky's view of learning emphasises:
explanation: Vygotsky's social constructivism sees learning as socially mediated.

text: Kolb's experiential learning cycle begins with:
explanation: The cycle: concrete experience, reflective observation, abstract conceptualisation, active experimentation.

text: Which of the following is an audio aid?
explanation: A tape recorder or radio presents sound only.

text: A major advantage of computer-assisted instruction is that it:
options: Provides immediate feedback and lets pupils learn at their own pace
explanation: CAI offers individual pacing and instant feedback.

text: In the 5E model of teaching, the "Explore" phase involves:
options: Students engaging in hands-on activities to gather experience
explanation: In Explore, learners investigate and gather evidence before explanations are given.

text: Models of teaching are grouped by Joyce and Weil into families such as:
options: Information processing, social, personal and behavioural
explanation: The four families are information processing, social, personal and behavioural systems.

text: The first step of the scientific method is usually:
explanation: The method starts from a problem, then hypothesis, experiment, observation and conclusion.

text: The deductive method proceeds from:
explanation: Deduction applies a general rule to specific cases.

text: A major merit of the laboratory method is that it:
options: Gives first-hand experience and develops skills
explanation: Students gain direct experience and manipulative skills.

text: The constructivist approach differs from the behaviourist approach because in it learners:
options: Build their own understanding from experience
explanation: Constructivism stresses learners' own construction of meaning.

text: A modern trend in science curriculum construction is to make it:
explanation: Modern curricula favour activity-based, learner-centred approaches.

text: A pupils' workbook in science is used mainly to:
explanation: Workbooks give practice and record of activities.

text: A science museum helps in science learning by:
options: Displaying exhibits that make ideas concrete and interesting
explanation: Exhibits give direct, interesting experience of scientific ideas.

text: An important advantage of objective-type tests is:
explanation: The score does not depend on the scorer's opinion.

text: An advantage of the grading system over marks is that it:
options: Reduces unhealthy competition and examination stress
explanation: Grades group learners in bands and lower pressure.

text: Reflective practice by a teacher means:
options: Thinking critically about one's own teaching to improve it
explanation: Reflection on practice is a key to professional growth.
